title: Friends Who Live Far Away
sentences: My closest friend moved to another country three years ago.
At first we spoke almost every week.
Then the calls became monthly, and then rarer than that.
Neither of us had decided to speak less; it simply happened.
The time difference makes a casual conversation difficult.
By the time she finishes work, I am already asleep.
We now write long messages instead, which suits us better.
She tells me things in writing that she would never say aloud.
I saw her in the spring for the first time since she left.
Within an hour it was as though no time had passed at all.
